title: Allow-list provenance for non-PII roles (S5 gate medium on SEC2-017)
story: As a carrier privacy officer I want auditor and integration roles to receive no free-text provenance at all so that PII the extractor never labelled cannot leak through spans or snippets
acceptance: For auditor and integration, extraction responses carry no provenance.span, snippet or other free-text excerpt for any field (allow-list: field name, masked value or non-pii value, confidence, page/offset numbers only); test includes PII that was never extracted as a field (e.g. a third name only in the span)
node --test tests/unit/evidence/ passes; SEC2-017 todo test still passes locally; tests/e2e and tests/security show no new failures; do not edit tests/security
brief: The S5-AI-02 fix is a deny-list (drops a span only when it contains a pii:true value). Replace it with an allow-list for non-PII roles.
